title: Caesium Atomic Clock, 1955

passages.locator: Selected catalogue description or historical narrative
passages.note: Catalogue object 1962-59 is a caesium clock built by Louis Essen and J. V. L. Parry at the National Physical Laboratory, Teddington in 1955. The museum expresses its accuracy as one second in 300 years; this is an equivalent rate, not an observed 300-year operation.
